purpose: The straight pump returns concentrate to the weighed OXO cup for the repeated measurements. A removes concentrate from the cup and B adds concentrate to it.
pair_method: The signed change is the after display minus the before display. These indications include forces transmitted by the hoses. Endpoint UTC times identify visually read LCD frames. The CSV includes groups acknowledged by the controller.

independent_display_trace.timebase: UTC host receipt of each iPhone frame. The replay follows the sampled LCD in order, with the original timestamp under each frame. A gap occupies a single placeholder frame with its start and end recorded in the CSV.
independent_display_trace.display_g: A visually read sample, or a seven-segment reading whose decodable thresholds agree and that is within 0.4 g of another similarly readable sample within 2.5 seconds. Isolated changing readings and conflicting segments have a separate unchecked candidate when available. Empty readings are missing values.
independent_display_trace.replay_processing: The LCD was rectified and contrast-enhanced from the blue channel. The timestamp is the only overlay on readable frames. The numeric CSV comes from the original crops before video compression.
independent_display_trace.controller_session: Host console session windows from acknowledged trials include setup and settling. The acknowledged board drive durations and trial endpoints accompany each matched measurement in return-rig.csv.
independent_display_trace.reconnection: Camera recovery caused a recording gap across part of shape050-b-r1. Initial frames on reconnection were out of focus. The first readable post-run plateau and the later named sample are both identified in the paired measurements.
independent_display_trace.frozen_camera_frames: The host continued to receive images during brief Continuity Camera freezes. Consecutive byte-identical saved JPEG crops are marked as missing throughout the duplicate interval.
independent_display_trace.parked_reconnection: The camera was reopened after the guide-on reference and before any further pump commands.
independent_display_trace.sampling_resolution: The independent trace samples supported load through complete controller batches. Each named scale pair measures total supported load change across a batch.

local_weight_windows.bounds: Each pair has independent display samples ending at its pre-run still and starting at its post-run still. Windows stop at adjacent named measurements. Some windows include fewer samples than their nominal duration because the camera or digits were unreadable.
local_weight_windows.summary: Minima, medians and maxima describe observed variation in the supported cup, tubing and scale. The signed difference of window medians is included when both windows contain at least two readable samples. The paired readings retain the exact displayed tenth of a gram.

blank_groups: Rows at zero commanded drive record the supported-cup response with the controller active and both pumps stationary.

turnaround_check.observation: The display performed its self-test as the command began. Subsequent indications rose. Its before reading is missing during startup. The cup’s camera measurements for this train are in ../side-optical.csv.

scale_power_down.observation: The moving phone images continued to show the physical scale and its dark LCD. The final lit indication is local to the previous tare.

guide_condition: The two tube guides were fitted on A during all powered runs in this record. The series ends at the first dark scale display after the final guided reference.

raw_csv_fields.return-rig.csv: before_g and after_g are total supported load indications. cup_gain_g_signed is their signed difference.
raw_csv_fields.return-windows.csv: The pre and post fields summarize the same supported load. median_cup_gain_g_signed is the difference of the local window medians.
